programme.title: The Greatest Showman
programme.desc: P. T. Barnum (Ellis Rubin) is the son of a tailor who works for the Hallett family.The boy falls in love with his employers' daughter, Charity (Skylar Dunn).They stay in touch for many years, and when they are adults, they get married.One day, Phineas (Hugh Jackman) loses his job.Wanting to ensure the happiness of his wife (Michelle Williams) and two daughters, a man opens a wax museum.When the idea turns out to be unsuccessful, he decides to show visitors live exhibits.He employs outstanding people - including: the acrobat Anne (Zendaya) and her brother W. D. (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II), the woman with the beard Lettie Lutz (Keala Settle) and Charles Stratton (Sam Humphrey).The show attracts a large audience but receives negative reviews;Barnum's museum is called a circus.To improve his reputation, the man invites Phillip Carlyle (Zac Efron) to cooperate with him.He soon meets Swedish singer Jenny Lind (Rebecca Ferguson).The artist's performance turns out to be a breakthrough for his career.

programme.title: Cash For Gold
programme.desc: American province.After the death of her soldier husband in Afghanistan, Grace (Deborah Puette), a single mother, loses herself in alcohol addiction.The widow, in order to provide a decent life for her son (Sawyer Gacka) and protect their house from being taken over by the bank, decides to fight for a change of fate.He joins an AA group and takes a job in a pawn shop owned by the only Muslim family in town.Over time, her friendly relationship with the owners of the plant, Mohammad (Marcelo Tubert) and his son, Hasan (Farshad Farahat), becomes less and less popular with the local community.

programme.title: Silent Trees
programme.desc: Runa, a sixteen-year-old Kurdish girl, flees Iraq with her family from ISIS attacks.Over time, he reaches the Polish-Belarusian border and then to Poland, where he and his relatives receive asylum.Unfortunately, the price the family pays for getting to Europe is high.Runa's mother, being in an advanced stage of pregnancy, dies in the hospital due to exhaustion caused by her stay in the border forest.Now Runa has to grow up at an accelerated pace - she becomes the head of the family, because she has to take care of not only her four younger brothers, but also her father, who cannot cope with the growing difficulties.

programme.title: U.S. Against The World: Four Years With The Men National Soccer Team
programme.desc: The story of the US men's national soccer team on its way to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America. The film shows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah and Weston McKennie personally and professionally.

programme.title: Apolonia, Apolonia
programme.desc: A painting made over several years, which shows the personal and artistic development of Apolonia Sokol, a young generation painter with Polish roots.Her works have been shown in France and the USA.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Macbeth returns from his war expedition.The witches predict a great future for him.The man's ambition and lust for power awaken, additionally fueled by his wife.However, his path to the throne will be bloody.

programme.title: Insomnia
programme.desc: It's a polar summer in northern Alaska.Police officer Will Dormer (Al Pacino) arrives in the town of Nightmute with his partner Hap Eckhart (Martin Donovan).The men are to find the perpetrator of the murder of a seventeen-year-old girl.Will doesn't feel comfortable up north.The polar summer deepens his insomnia.The trail leads to writer Walter Finch (Robin Williams), who was friends with the victim.While chasing him in the thick fog, Will shoots his partner.Hap dies.In his last words, he accuses Will of doing it to prevent an internal investigation.Dormer covers his tracks by directing suspicions at Finch.A writer who witnessed Hap's murder begins to blackmail Will.Meanwhile, local policewoman Ellie Burr (Hilary Swank) is getting closer to discovering the truth about Hap's death.

programme.title: Priscilla
programme.desc: Young Elvis Presley (Jacob Elrodi) meets teenage Priscilla Beaulieu (Cailee Spaeny).He begins to prepare the girl for the role of his future wife.Over time, a serious feeling develops between them.However, life in the spotlight exposes their relationship to numerous tests, including from the star's numerous lovers.Priscilla, living detached from reality, slowly begins to learn about herself.Will her transformation affect the future of this marriage?Sofia Coppola returns with another story about female youth."Priscilla" is the result of the director's cooperation with the ex-wife of the American rock star, Elvis Presley.The director of "Curses of Innocence" and "Temptation" once again juxtaposes passion, romance and great love with the cruel realities of life.

programme.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The supporting penguin agents known from the three parts of "Madagascar" return to the cinema screen in their own production.Great entertainment for younger and older viewers guaranteed.Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private engage in a mission on which the fate of the world depends.They must face the geneticist Oktawiusz Mackiewicz, who dreams of controlling the Earth.In fact, the enemy of flightless birds is a vengeful octopus.It intends to settle accounts with visitors from Antarctica.Penguin agents join forces with the secret organization North Wind, which includes: the Greenland seal Detonator, the muscular teddy bear Kapral and the snowy owl Ewa.They are commanded by the mysterious Arctic Wolf, the Covert Agent.Good company awakens the competitive spirit in Skipper.As befits real superspies, the flightless unit travels halfway around the world.He visits, among others:Venice, Antarctica, Shanghai and New York.

programme.title: The Emoji Movie
programme.desc: Millions of smartphones around the world have an application for sending messages through which you can communicate your feelings and moods.This is where the city of Textopolis, where emotes live, is hidden.The task of each of them is to express a different state of mind.The exception is Minek, who can express every emotion.However, he dreams of being like others.Together with Piątek and the superhacker Matrix, they set off on a journey through the phone in search of a solution.The animated film is directed by Tony Leondis ("Kung Fu Panda: Secrets of the Masters").The Polish language version featured, among others: Paweł Ciołkosz, Szymon Roszak, Monika Pikuła and Katarzyna Kwiatkowska.

programme.title: Buffalo Kids
programme.desc: Tom and Mary arrive in New York to meet Uncle Niall.The relative who was supposed to pick them up doesn't show up at the port.The children, hiding in the train, set off on a journey through the Wild West.

programme.title: Hollywood On Set 23
programme.desc: The program takes viewers behind the scenes of film production.In each episode, the creators discuss three cinema hits.They show how spectacular effects, impressive sets and acting performances are created.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Part 2
programme.desc: Bella and Edward are already married.However, the young couple did not have time to enjoy each other.The girl quickly became pregnant, but it turned out that it was life-threatening.Edward couldn't watch his beloved suffer and made the dramatic decision to transform her into a vampire.This was the only way he could save Bella from dying during the grueling labor.After the metamorphosis, the young woman improves her skills and learns to control her hunger.Together with her husband, she enjoys watching the rapid development of her extraordinary daughter, Renesmee, who at the age of three months looks like a two-year-old and can show her thoughts through images.The family idyll does not last long.There is a suspicion that the girl is an immortal child whose existence is against the law established by the Volturi.Renesmee and her parents are at risk of death.Edward and his family decide to defend themselves.They summon vampires from all corners of the world and prepare to confront the Volturi.

programme.title: Wildcat
programme.desc: 1950s.A devout Catholic living in the American South, Flannery O'Connor (Maya Hawke), wins a writing competition.Soon he goes to New York to meet with a publisher, hoping to interest him in his novel "The Wisdom of Blood".However, they do not reach an agreement.Flannery is also dating her mentor, Robert Lowell (Philip Ettinger), with whom she has feelings.After returning home, the woman notices disturbing symptoms of illness.It turns out it was lupus, from which her father died.Flannery becomes disabled, but he can count on the care of his mother, Regina (Laura Linney), although their relationship can be strained.All the time, the young woman is struggling with an internal problem, she is afraid that her writing is contrary to her faith.Only the wise advice of Father Flynn (Liam Neeson) makes her focus on writing.This is also influenced by the information about Robert's wedding to another woman.A moving, brilliantly realized picture, inspired by the biography of the famous American short story writer and novelist.Four-time Oscar nominee Ethan Hawke was behind the camera.

programme.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
programme.desc: Sarah (Margot Robbie) and David (Colin Farrell) meet at a friend's wedding.They go on an expedition during which they relive the most important moments from their past.

credits.actor: Father of the Bride - Mike Meldman

programme.title: Another Simple Favor
programme.desc: Emily Nelson (Blake Lively), who was sentenced to 20 years in prison, regains her freedom.She is planning a wedding on the island of Capri, and an old friend becomes her bridesmaid.A crime occurs during the ceremony.

programme.title: Victor Frankenstein
programme.desc: Scientist Victor (James McAvoy) and his protégé Igor research immortality together.Over time, the consequences of their experiments become more and more terrifying.

programme.title: Lisa Frankenstein
programme.desc: The year is 1989. Lonely high school student Lisa Swallows (Kathryn Newton) hates her life.Her father (Joe Chrest) remarried and moved into the home of his new girlfriend (Carla Gugino) and stepdaughter (Liza Soberano), forcing his daughter to change schools.The Outsider often spends time at the local cemetery, Bachelor's Grove, exploring moss-covered gravestones and imagining the stories of the people buried beneath them.One night, a mysterious storm breaks out over the cemetery.Lightning strikes the earth, resurrecting a man (Cole Sprouse) from the Victorian era.Meeting him changes Lisa's life.

programme.title: Freaky
programme.desc: Millie (Kathryn Newton) lives in a small American town and struggles with numerous problems.He can only count on a pair of loyal friends, Josh (Misha Osherovich) and Nyla (Celeste O'Connor).She is ridiculed by her peers and has just lost her father.To make matters worse, he becomes the target of a psychopath roaming the area, the Blissfield Butcher (Vince Vaughn).The bloody incident has surprising consequences - the girl, stabbed with an antique dagger on a moonlit night, magically switches bodies with her tormentor.In the morning he wakes up as a wanted murderer, and the Butcher can now go hunting in the form of a delicate blonde.Millie has only 24 hours to reverse the spell.Christopher Landon, the creator of "Die Another Day", pays tribute to the classics of horror cinema.He skillfully plays with convention, referring to "Halloween" or "Scream".

programme.title: I.S.S
programme.desc: There are American and Russian astronauts on the International Space Station.The US team consists of Dr. Kira Foster (Ariana DeBose), who recently joined the team, officer Christian Campbell (John Gallagher Jr.) and the mission commander Gordon Barrett (Chris Messina).On a daily basis, they cooperate with the second group, which includes Weronika Vetrow (Masha Mashkova), Nikolaj Pulov (Costa Ronin) and his brother Alexei (Pilou Asbaek).Despite political and cultural differences, the astronauts get along great.There is a friendly atmosphere at the station, and Gordon and Weronika, who have started an affair, have something more in common.Everything changes when the six of them notice a terrifying phenomenon on Earth.Everyone watches with growing horror as a wave of fire spreads on the surface of the planet, where their homes and loved ones are located.This can only mean one thing - the outbreak of nuclear war.The situation escalates when Barrett learns that Russia has attacked the United States and receives an order from the US government to take control of the station.Together with Christian and Kira, they suspect that their colleagues received a similar task.Additionally, they discover that the station is currently orbiting too low.It will fall to Earth if help does not arrive within 24 hours.A fight for survival begins, and the former friends now turn on each other.

programme.title: When Luxury Holidays Go Horribly Wrong
programme.desc: Exotic locations become the background for tragedy.Viewers will learn the stories of people who experienced accidents and natural disasters while on vacation.Some have fallen victim to fraudsters.

programme.title: Victor Frankenstein
programme.desc: Scientist Victor (James McAvoy) and his protégé Igor research immortality together.Over time, the consequences of their experiments become more and more terrifying.

programme.title: Night of the Zoopocalypse
programme.desc: In the middle of the night, a meteorite falls on the zoo.Thanks to him, some of the inhabitants turn into neon, jelly-like creatures with suspicious properties, and the entire zoo is thrown into chaos.The clever wolf Gracie and the haughty puma Dan, who have been out of each other's way until now, decide to put aside their personal grudges to save the animals.Together with a group of daredevils, including Frida the capybara, Felix the baboon, Ash the nervous ostrich, Xavier the lemur and the charming Hippo, they create a crazy rescue team.The Polish language version was attended by, among others:Magdalena Boczarska, Marcin Piętowski and Mateusz Banasiuk.

programme.desc: Emily Nelson (Blake Lively), who was sentenced to 20 years in prison, regains her freedom.She is planning a wedding on the island of Capri, and an old friend becomes her bridesmaid.A crime occurs during the ceremony.

programme.title: The Goldsmith's Secret
programme.desc: 1999. Goldsmith Juan Pablo travels from Spain to New York for an exhibition of his works.On the way he passes through his hometown.He will meet Celia, a great love who changed his life.

programme.title: Goodbye, Christopher Robin
programme.desc: End of World War I.A.A.Milne (Domhnall Gleeson) moves to the countryside with his family and, finding inspiration in the toys of his son Christopher Robin (Will Tilston), creates a story about the adventures of Winnie the Pooh, who will soon become a children's favorite.However, the quickly achieved international success is not only about profits.The price of A.A.'s fameMilne will suffer not only himself, but also his wife Daphne (Margot Robbie), their son and his caregiver Olive (Kelly Macdonald).The moving film with biographical elements received a BIFA nomination for best supporting actress - Kelly Macdonald.The music composed by Carter Burwell was appreciated by the World Academy of Film Music.

credits.actor: Christopher Robin Aged 6 Months - Stanley Hamlin

programme.title: The Other Guys
programme.desc: Hot-tempered New York detective Terry Hoitz (Mark Wahlberg) dreams of his name going down in police history.Unfortunately, he is punitively delegated to office work.His dim-witted partner Allen Gamble (Will Ferrell) is not keen on catching criminals and would rather spend his days behind a desk.As a result, those with completely opposite characters do not like each other.However, both of them share a feeling of inferiority because they are still in the shadow of the local police celebrities: P.K.Highsmith (Samuel L. Jackson) and Christopher Danson (Dwayne Johnson).The opportunity to take their place comes sooner than they might expect.When the famous duo is killed in action, Terry and Allen face the opportunity of a lifetime.They are on the trail of a scandal involving multimillionaire David Ershon (Steve Coogan).If they manage to find evidence of a crime and catch the culprits, they will gain recognition and decorations.However, if they fail, they will face professional degradation.

credits.actor: reporter na konferencji prasowej - Andrew Secunda

programme.title: Beautiful
programme.desc: The intertwined adventures of several women who are looking for happiness and fulfillment at different stages of life.Magda (Marta Nieradkiewicz) tries to reconcile raising children and running a home with her professional ambitions.Distrustful Basia (Marta Ścisłowicz) avoids love, even though she wants it very much.Krysia (Hanna Śleszyńska), a married woman for 30 years, tries to arouse a bit of enthusiasm in the bored and apathetic Władek (Olaf Lubaszenko).Businesswoman Agata (Katarzyna Herman) is successful at work, but cannot find a common language with her daughter.Julia (Kamila Urzędowska) tries to make it in an industry that values ​​only youth and beauty.She discovers how much she will have to sacrifice.Polish remake of the German comedy "Wunderschön" from 2022.

programme.title: Mr. Popper's Penguins
programme.desc: Tom Popper (Jim Carrey) is a well-paid agent who acquires real estate for a development company.He gives the owners of the buildings he is interested in visions of exciting journeys and amazing adventures that may await them once they sell their apartments in the city center.A cynical and calculating pragmatist thinks only about money and, without paying attention to people, to reach the goal.His life begins to get complicated when he finds a live penguin in a shipment from Antarctica.As if that wasn't enough, he soon becomes the guardian of five more animals that are unusual in urban realities.

programme.title: IF
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Bea (Cailey Fleming) has to live with her grandmother (Fiona Shaw) after her mother's death.Her father (John Krasinski) is in the hospital awaiting surgery.One evening, the girl hears a mysterious noise.Following the sound, she sees an animated figure and faints from the emotion.She wakes up in the apartment of her neighbor Calvin (Ryan Reynolds), who introduces her to fantastic creatures - Blossom and Blue.The creatures created thanks to children's imagination are to be sent to a retirement home.The girl learns that she has been entrusted with a special mission related to their fate.
